description: Today, Senator Cindy Holscher announced the launch of her statewide Common Sense and Lower Costs Tour, kicking off Saturday, September 26, in Marysville. Over the next two weeks, Senator Cindy Holscher will travel the state, with at least 16 stops planned, to hear directly from Kansans and share her plan to lower costs for working families. The tour spends its first week in eastern Kansas before heading west for week two.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Holscher Launches Statewide “Common Sense and Lower Costs Tour” | Cindy Holscher for Governor
